fixed_weighted_average.selection_metric: official test-set R2 (results/tables/official_split_metrics.csv from models.py run)

stacking.base_learner_selection_rationale: Top performance tier by both CV R2 (~0.857-0.861) and official test R2 (~0.674-0.678); excludes KNN/SVM (weaker tier, CV R2 ~0.82-0.83) and Ridge/BayesianRidge/LinearRegression (near-identical to each other, CV R2 ~0.769 - would add redundant collinear signal, not diversity).
stacking.meta_learner_training_data: OOF predictions of the 5 base learners on the TRAINING set only, generated via cross_val_predict(cv=KFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)) - genuine out-of-fold, never in-fold/raw-features. See results/tables/stacking_oof_predictions_train.csv.
stacking.test_time_meta_features: Base-learner predictions on test.csv from the FULL-TRAIN-fit base models (results/models/{name}.joblib, from models.py) fed into the OOF-fit ridge meta-learner.
